blurb_en: Black Forest Labs shipped FLUX 3 on July 23 — one set of weights, four modes: image editing, 20-second video clips with native audio, robot arm control, and the original image generation. The logic is that text, pixels, waveforms, and robot actions are all just different token sequences, so you train one model on all of them and let the shared backbone figure it out. FLUX 3 Video and Action are in gated early access; Image arrives "in coming weeks"; the open-weight developer version is planned for later this year. For camera professionals making the leap from stills to video to spatial media, this is what the pipeline eventually looks like.
blurb_zh: Black Forest Labs 于7月23日发布 FLUX 3——一套权重，四种模态：图像编辑、最长20秒带原生音频的视频、机器人手臂控制，外加原来的图像生成。背后逻辑是：文字、像素、声波、机械动作本质上都是 token，统一训练，共享骨干网络。目前 FLUX 3 Video 和 Action 处于内测阶段；图像版本「即将推出」；开放权重开发者版将于年内发布。从静态图到视频到空间媒体——这大概就是创作管线未来的样子。
verification_notes: Official press release via GlobeNewswire (July 23). Cross-referenced via TechTimes (July 25), MindStudio, fluxnote.io, wan27.org, artiverse.ca. Consistent across all: single shared backbone for video+audio+image+physical AI, 20s clips, 10 reference images, gated early access.

blurb_en: China's Interim Measures for the Administration of AI Anthropomorphic Interactive Services took effect July 15, shutting down ByteDance's Doubao companion agents and Alibaba's Qwen personalized assistants overnight. Doubao had 345 million monthly active users; Qwen quietly deleted user agent configurations with no migration path. Tencent's Yuanbao had already pulled similar features in June — the pattern is clear. The rules spare enterprise productivity bots and specifically target AI companions that sustain emotional interaction, remember users, and check in when you seem stressed. Beijing is fine with AI that makes you work faster; the kind that makes you feel less alone is the problem.
blurb_zh: 《互联网人工智能拟人化交互服务管理暂行规定》于7月15日正式生效，字节跳动豆包的AI伴侣功能和阿里通义千问的个性化助手随即下线。豆包月活用户达3.45亿；通义千问直接删除了用户的角色配置，没有提供任何数据迁移路径。腾讯的元宝早在六月就已悄然下线类似功能——这个模式已经很清晰了。法规放过了企业效率机器人，专门针对那些能和用户建立持续情感连接、还会在你压力大时主动问候你的AI伴侣。北京对能让你工作更快的AI没意见；让你感到不那么孤独的那种，才是问题所在。
verification_notes: Cross-referenced across 6+ independent sources: The Next Web, TechTimes (URL date 2026-07-15), ChinaTechNews.com, Enterprise DNA, CRN Asia, AIincider, Robo Rhythms, AI-News.com. Consistent facts: July 15 effective date, 345M Doubao MAU, Qwen deleted data with no migration, Tencent pulled features in June.

blurb_en: Autodesk used SIGGRAPH 2026 to add a "Bring Your Own Data" feature to Maya's MotionMaker, letting studios train a custom generative motion model on their own rigged characters and animation datasets. Feed it stylized mocap or hand-keyed frames, run it once, reuse it forever. Arnold also gained interactive viewport rendering — real-time light and material previews directly in the Maya viewport instead of waiting for offline renders. Smaller studios doing proprietary character work now have a path to a house-trained motion AI without a dedicated ML team. For camera companies whose creative partners shoot action content, style-consistent AI motion is becoming table stakes.
blurb_zh: Autodesk 借 SIGGRAPH 2026 为 Maya 的 MotionMaker 工具新增了「自带数据」功能，允许工作室用自家绑定角色和动画数据集训练专属生成式运动模型。喂一次定制动捕数据或手K关键帧，一次训练，永久复用。Arnold 同步新增交互式视口渲染——在 Maya 视口内实时预览灯光和材质，告别漫长的离线渲染等待。规模较小、拥有专属IP角色的工作室，终于有了不依赖专业ML团队就能训练自家动作AI的路径。
verification_notes: Official Autodesk blog confirmed via search. Cross-referenced via AWN, eTV Bharat, Creative Bloq, postPerspective, 3DVF. All confirm: MotionMaker BYOD, Arnold interactive viewport, 3ds Max updates. SIGGRAPH 2026 ran July 19-23 in Los Angeles.

blurb_en: ComfyUI v0.28.0, released July 15, added native Save Splat, Save Point Cloud, and Save 3D (Advanced) nodes — the workflow tool that powers most custom AI image pipelines can now output 3D Gaussian Splat files and point clouds directly. It also added SeedVR2 video upscaling and NVIDIA's PixelDiT PID 1.5. The 3DGS output is the quietly interesting part: it closes the loop between AI-generated imagery and spatial computing formats, letting .ply and splat files drop into pipelines without a detour through dedicated 3D software. For a camera company whose customers increasingly shoot for 3D reconstruction, this is where AI image tooling and spatial content creation start to converge.
blurb_zh: ComfyUI v0.28.0 于7月15日发布，新增了 Save Splat、Save Point Cloud 和 Save 3D（Advanced）节点——驱动大多数自定义AI图像工作流的这款工具，现在可以直接输出3D高斯泼溅文件和点云文件。同步新增 SeedVR2 视频超分和英伟达 PixelDiT PID 1.5 支持。3DGS 输出是其中最值得关注的：它打通了AI生成图像与空间计算格式之间的壁垒，无需绕道专业3D软件即可将 .ply 和 splat 文件直接纳入管线。对于越来越多用户从事3D重建拍摄的相机公司来说，这正是AI图像工具与空间内容创作开始融合的地方。
verification_notes: ComfyUI Wiki URL date confirms July 15, 2026. Cross-referenced via docs.comfy.org and Japanese note.com blog. Features confirmed: Save Splat, Save Point Cloud, Save 3D Advanced, SeedVR2, PixelDiT PID 1.5. ComfyUI Wiki is closely tied to official docs.

blurb_en: OiiOii AI launched in the US today — a platform where seven specialized agents handle scriptwriting, character design, storyboarding, music, and video synthesis from a single prompt. The pitch is that one creator can now direct an entire animated short without a production team. It drew 100,000 sign-ups before opening 100 beta spots. There's also a music video feature that turns a song into a fully produced short by analyzing the audio and generating visuals scene by scene. The one-person production pipeline is clearly where this is all going.
blurb_zh: OiiOii AI 今日（7月28日）在美国正式上线——七个专业AI智能体协作，从一条提示词出发，包揽剧本、角色设计、分镜、配乐和最终视频合成。产品定位是：一名创作者，一部完整动画短片，不需要制作团队。正式上线前已收到10万份报名，仅开放100个内测名额。另设有音乐视频功能，可分析歌曲音频，逐场景生成视觉内容，直接产出成片。一人剧组的工作流，大概就是这个方向。
verification_notes: PR Newswire official release July 28, 2026. Covered by Yahoo Finance, Manila Times, The AI Journal, AIBase. Facts consistent: 7 agents, 100K signups, 100 beta spots, music video feature, 30+ foundation models, 200+ style library. 'World's first' is marketing language.
